summary_md: This looks high-impact (auth/payments/sends/migrations). The lane planned it but paused for your go before doing anything. Plan: ## Plan for ARCA-61 — Saved lists not persisting across login  ### What I found from a read-only audit (no files touched)  The watchlist backend is actually well-scoped, which narrows this to a few specific suspects rather than a broad "audit everything":  - **`modules/watchlist/handlers.ts`**: every route requires a valid session cookie, resolves `X-User-Id` server-side from the session token, and all reads/writes filter by `watchlists.user_id`. Not spoofable, no default/anonymous watchlist id. - **`client/src/pages/WatchlistPage.tsx`**: no localStorage/sessionStorage fallback found — it
